name: node-api
extractedFrom: Newly created — no empirical source. No other pack was opened, not even as a format reference (only assets/pack-resource-template.md was used)
policyEngineNote: There is no row-level policy engine. The application connects to the DB over a trusted connection, so **a missing ownership filter is a data leak outright**. Carrying the BaaS axis's (supabase) 'RLS is the backup, so the application check is defense in depth' narrative over to this axis produces exactly the opposite instruction — a value that must be passed on when generating the seam

exampleDomain.note: Every pack and seam uses the same example domain. L0 issues the vocabulary policy (`vocab-task`) from these values and the gate blocks any divergence — measured, the frontend used /tasks while the backend used /notes and the complete examples could not run against each other

fixesVariantsNote: The handler shape (Express 5 routers and error middleware) and the query shape (Prisma Client + migrate) are the premise of the entire pack body. For a project that picked NestJS, DI, decorators, and modules are a different system rather than a variant of Express, so a separate axis pack (node-nest) is needed. For a project that picked Drizzle, backend/aws-container owns that shape
runtimeNote: This is a server runtime version, not an npm dependency. Put it in pkgs and `npm i` fetches the wrong package — `postgres` is Porsager's driver and has no version 16 (measured by C2)

resources.nav: layer boundaries (routes → services → db) · Express 5 app assembly · router mounting · 404/error middleware order · async handlers
Prisma Client singleton · ownership filter · checking the affected row count · transactions · pagination · N+1 and select · running migrations
writing Zod schemas · request parsing helpers · doubling up with DB constraints · environment variable schema · boot-time failure
domain error → status code mapping · detecting Prisma error codes (P2002·P2025) · normalizing ZodError · no existence leaks
Vitest setup · supertest router tests · integration tests against a real DB · test DB isolation · seeding and cleanup
graceful shutdown · health checks (live/ready) · connection pool sizing · structured logging · migration deploy order · observing slow queries

seamSlotNotes.api-endpoints: Router shape + request/response envelope + emitting the error envelope. The envelope is a function of the wire contract, so the combination decides it, not the axis
seamSlotNotes.auth-boundaries: how the token is verified (self-issued JWT · session · external IdP) · requireAuth wiring · roles/scopes · login and logout flow. **The authentication method is not a function of the axis** — whether the frontend axis has a server runtime is what decides between a session cookie and a bearer token
seamSlotNotes.complete-example: a pass through migration → schema → query → service → router → test

clusters.why: EnvSchema and the request schemas are a function of the error code table and vice versa. ZodError → the field-error envelope and Prisma P2002 → 409 come out of one table. It is the pilot because it is where the `AppError` shape from requires is most entangled
Ownership of the prisma singleton and the wiring in makeApp are the same decision. The layering discipline 'the data layer knows nothing about HTTP' also spans both files
They share the process lifetime (boot · shutdown · pool · health checks). Test DB isolation and connection pool sizing handle the same resource

knownGaps.what: the type check does not pass — there is no generated Prisma client
knownGaps.detail: `pack-smoke.sh --pack --online` reports **FAIL 1**: `Module '@prisma/client' has no exported member 'Task'`·`'TaskStatus'`·`Namespace 'Prisma' has no exported member 'TaskSelect'` (TS2305·TS2694). These names are **what `prisma generate` produces from the schema**, so they do not exist from an install alone with no schema — the pack's code is not wrong; the verification environment does not run code generation. **`--regress` does not run pack-smoke, so this failure had been invisible until now** (first observed on 2026-08-24). There are two possible repairs: have pack-smoke restore the schema fence from the prisma pack and run `prisma generate`, or declare this pack's type check explicitly unchecked. The former adds a check, so we decide when this class becomes a problem in a second pack

knownGaps.where: resources/operations.md (promised by the nav in pack.json)
knownGaps.detail: Without a real Prisma we could not state the shape of `$on('query')` or the `log` option with confidence, so it was left empty. We followed 'an empty slot beats wrong content' (reported by C3). The nav wording is left as something to fill in later

knownGaps.what: the example domain has no relation
knownGaps.detail: N+1 cannot be shown with the single `Task` model, so the `Comment` relation was introduced as an example (the measurement used that schema too). **If the seam's complete-example uses only a Task with no relation, the §5 code floats free in the assembly** — a value to pass on when generating the seam (reported by C2)
